summary: First-finish smoke testing for Tech Yantra site. Backend: 8 endpoints exercised (portfolio, blog, careers, inquiries POST, newsletter POST dedup, auth login, auth me, admin inquiries list+delete, register, RBAC 403). Frontend: home renders all sections including 12 services and 8 portfolio cards, theme toggle works, WhatsApp float visible, blog list+detail navigate, careers shows 4 jobs, admin login redirects to /admin, all 6 admin tabs present with correct stats, ProtectedRoute redirects unauthenticated users from /admin to /login.
passed: POST /api/newsletter subscribe works; duplicate returns 'Already subscribed'
POST /api/auth/login admin returns JWT with role=admin
GET /api/auth/me with admin Bearer returns role=admin
POST /api/auth/register creates client account with role=client
Home page loads with hero CTA, 12 service cards, 8 portfolio cards, contact form testids, WhatsApp float
Theme toggle changes html class dark <-> light
/blog lists 3 posts; /blog/:slug detail page renders H1
/careers renders 4 job listings with Apply buttons
/login with admin creds redirects to /admin and renders all 6 tabs (inquiries/users/portfolio/blog/careers/newsletter)
ProtectedRoute: clearing ty_token then visiting /admin redirects to /login
notes: Contact form Radix Select fields are non-input elements (cannot be filled via input.fill); POST /api/inquiries verified directly. FAQ items query found only 1 visible (likely accordion collapses others or uses different testid pattern) — not a blocker since user can interact. WhatsApp window.open after submit handled gracefully via popup listener.
